source_text: Punch your makeup war paint in the face. And also every time I say punch, you must have a ledger that actually saves the punch. That is a to-do. I want to hear your action first. And I still have thirst. That rhymed. I do that all the time.
action: Ritsu squared to the mirror, dragged a knuckle through the war paint, and tapped the reflection between the eyes.
rule: Every whole-word punch in a Drew-authored turn must be represented in the Punch Ledger; one ledger event per turn preserves exact source text and occurrence count.
